variants.diag_A: robot actor and robot critic; Phase 2 A architecture
variants.diag_B: robot actor and full 11-field fixture critic; B3 and B4 alias
variants.B5: full fixture critic until 50k, then freeze critic; actor continues
variants.B6: full fixture critic until 100k, distill to robot critic for 1000 minibatches, then ordinary SAC
variants.E0: robot-only actor and critic with shared policy encoder; no GT auxiliary loss
variants.E1: E0 architecture with angle MSE plus two-contact BCE auxiliary loss, weight 0.1
variants.E2: targeted follow-up: E1 auxiliary loss during first 100k steps, then disabled; same 500k and 5-seed budget
variants.E3: targeted follow-up: same 3000 BC updates with BC plus 0.1 GT prediction loss; no GT auxiliary online

analysis.q_probe: same 256 expert transitions across all saved Phase 2 A/B checkpoints
analysis.representation_probe: heldout seed 190000 baseline rollout, 16 environment instances train and 16 test
analysis.heldout: best and final checkpoints, 64 episodes each, seed 90000 + training seed
analysis.ci: 20000 seed-level bootstrap resamples; exact paired sign-flip p also reported
